questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: It reads clearly as a TCG listing page, but no live nudge appears on the screen, so the page's job isn't visible.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: No live entry point shows; 'Chat' (red) and 'Make offer' are the strongest controls.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Make offer', 'Chat', 'Read more' and 'Visit site now' predict what happens.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'PSA 10' and 'Mega Ultra Rare' suit a TCG buyer, but 'EN' on the grading band isn't explained.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: No decision is asked beyond offer or chat.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: 'Read more' tucks the rest of the details away.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Listing details, seller and recommendations all fit an LDP.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Details are label/value pairs with a short description.
